title: Know the Code First
look: Session board: a terminal, the code map's modules and bands, a README against the code, the assistant's context and the intake card on a dot-grid desk. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what's broken or hidden, jade for what's sound. The Sensei mark on the close.

scenes.name: Searching
scenes.desc: Without a map, the assistant greps and opens file after file.

scenes.name: The code map
scenes.desc: The map opens on modules; go down a level by choice: modules, then files, then symbols.

scenes.name: What it hides
scenes.desc: Upward dependencies, cycles, and files that change together with no import between them.

scenes.name: Doc drift
scenes.desc: A README names a method the code renamed; the doc is checked against the live code and flagged.

scenes.name: Context
scenes.desc: Sensei's tools hand the assistant the right context on the first turn, and say so when they can't.

scenes.name: Intake
scenes.desc: Describe the chunk of work; Sensei reads lifecycle, intent and risk, and recommends a way of working.

scenes.name: Sensei
scenes.desc: End card with the Sensei mark: know the code before you change it.
